usage.notice: The web preview uses its own pixel transforms in src/cafe-rig.js. It does not consume this template's normalized pivots, attachments or estimated sizes. Preview checks do not validate this import template's geometry.

identity.faceStyle: Adult oval face, warm almond-shaped eyes, subtle blush and a natural friendly smile.

validation.extractionVerificationScope: All 28 expected part files exist and their PNG signatures and IHDR dimensions were read. Every file has positive dimensions, 8-bit channels and PNG color type 6 (RGBA). This verifies export presence and header metadata, not pixel-level cleanup or joint alignment.
validation.notice: Extraction is complete. All normalized pivots, attachments, estimated sizes and draw orders remain initial estimates for this import template. Tune against the actual extracted PNG canvases before use; this file does not establish a validated pose or animation.
sourceLimitations: Generated color fringes remain along some extracted edges; alpha presence is not proof of fully cleaned transparency.
The generated source knees contain outlined caps, which may remain visible at assembled knee joints.

coordinates.local: Normalized [0,1] coordinates in each referenced part's full PNG canvas; origin at top-left, +x right, +y down. Transparent padding counts toward the canvas dimensions.
coordinates.pivot: pivot is measured in this node's local canvas. For a virtual node it is measured in that node's estimated frame.
coordinates.attachment: attach is measured in the parent node's local canvas or virtual frame. Match this node's pivot to that parent attachment before applying local rotation.
coordinates.size: size is estimated width and height as fractions of the reference stage. It is a placement hint, not a measured image size or a validated instruction to stretch the artwork.
coordinates.rotation: Positive degrees rotate clockwise about the local pivot. Parent transforms propagate to descendants.
coordinates.sides: left and right mean screen-left and screen-right in the neutral front view, not the character's anatomical left and right.
coordinates.rootPlacement: pelvis.stagePosition is normalized to the reference stage.

face_base.constraint: Blank face: no baked-in eyes, eyebrows or mouth; subtle blush is allowed.

assemblyRules: Load each of the 28 parts from its own PNG. Atlas cells are provenance, not replacement runtime layers.
Render exactly one selected variant per expression slot; eyes and brows assets each contain the paired features.
All parts default to visible except inactive expression variants and optional props. Local rotation defaults to zero.
Keep torso clothing with torso, each sleeve with its upper arm, and skirt/apron with pelvis. Tune overlapping joint coverage without merging limb segments.
Compute inherited transforms independently of draw order, then draw visible parts in ascending drawOrder. Facial variants share order intentionally because only one variant is active per slot.
head is a virtual frame: face, back hair, both side hair parts and bangs inherit it. Face features inherit face_base and therefore follow head movement.
Calves inherit their own thigh; shoes inherit their own calf. Forearms inherit their own upper arm; hands inherit their own forearm.
tray is anchored to hand_left and cup to tray. Enable props together only after tuning a supported carrying pose; hide descendants when a prop parent is hidden.
Do not use an atlas cutout containing another listed body segment or baked-in face features as a substitute for a genuinely isolated part.

Before marking geometry or visual validation flags true, visually inspect actual transparency, part completeness, all joints, clothing coverage and all four expressions using this template's transforms. File existence and PNG-header checks establish extraction status only. No animation or pose has been validated by this import template.
